title: SemanticOps
purpose: SemanticOps builds SRS (Semantic Record System, pronounced "source"): an open standard for portable semantic documents that people and AI can both understand and use. Knowledge moves intact, so anyone can inspect it, move it and keep using it without depending on the system that created it.

pages.title: Home
pages.summary: SRS is an open standard for portable semantic documents that people and AI can both understand and use. This site is generated from the records of an SRS repository.

pages.title: Model
pages.summary: The SRS model in order: Field, Type, Package, Note, Record, Relation, Container, repository, validation, rendering and identity, each with a real example.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.summary: How SRS is layered: a standard independent of any implementation, one core consumed identically by every client, and tool-enforced contracts for agents.

pages.title: Principles
pages.summary: The purpose, the governing core, the pairs SRS holds without settling, and the scope test that keeps the standard small.

pages.title: Projects
pages.summary: The four SemanticOps projects as kinds of technology: the standard, the reference engine, the browser editor and the VS Code extension.
